tools.name: search_articles
tools.description: Find source-backed art, illustration, artist-career, and buying-guide research by topic or question. Returns titles, summaries, publication dates, canonical pages, and structured API URLs.

tools.name: get_article
tools.description: Retrieve public metadata and the paid structured API URL for one article by slug. CMS-authorized clients may also request full Markdown directly from this tool.

tools.name: latest_articles
tools.description: List newly published art and illustration research with summaries, publication dates, canonical pages, and structured API URLs.

tools.name: articles_by_category
tools.description: Find source-backed articles in an art, illustration, buying-guide, or creative-career category by category name or slug.

tools.name: x402_payment_quickstart
tools.description: Return free x402 v2 payment instructions, network and asset metadata, working client examples, and the exact 0.001 USDC wallet-readiness endpoint. This tool never signs or spends funds.

tools.name: prepare_commission_quote
tools.description: Validate inputs for a benchmark-based art or illustration commission estimate covering deliverable, experience, complexity, finish, subjects, usage rights, revisions, rush timing, and expenses. Returns the paid x402 endpoint, current USDC price, dataset version, and exact request body without signin

tools.name: prepare_company_intelligence
tools.description: Validate a company query and choose a citation-first Company Snapshot, Company Change Monitor, Vendor Risk Brief, or Company Dossier. Returns the paid x402 endpoint, exact USDC price, source coverage, and normalized request body without signing or spending funds.
